page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number at top left. Main text in one column of full lines, with a centred sub-heading and a numbered series. To the right of the list of apostles, a brace grouping the names with the phrase "habent Tholosates" beside it, and a further line "Thomæ" at the foot right.

main_text.p: Articuli digiti gigantei, in Anglia ad Parathalassiæ.
Crepida, in Hispania ad Salvatoris: & alia Pictavii, ex serico rafo & auro segmentata.
Cathedra Episcopalis, cum veste Sacerdotali, vel Missatica, Romæ.
Altare, Romæ: & Pisis, in suburbio, quod ad mare vergit.
Catena, qua ligatus, Romæ, ad Petri.
Columna, super qua capite truncatus est, ad Anastasii.
main_text.head: III. PAULI seorsim.
CÆTERORUM X. APOSTOLORUM.

page.notes: Brace to the right of the apostle names grouping them, with "habent Tholosates" beside it; "Thomæ" at the bottom right. Some words in the text are uncertain, including the Latin Latin forms in the Pictavii and Tholosates lines. The line "Gladius ... auriculam" is cut off at the line end and marked as printed.
